global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette taken from the bottle: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (deep backgrounds and header blocks), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent text and highlighted words), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (light pills, cards and soft surfaces) and white #FFFFFF for main texts. Secondary support for this variation: light oak table #D9B27C, pastel lilac dumbbell #B9A3D9 and sticky-note yellow #FFE27A.
global_identity.visual_style: Real overhead smartphone photo of a kitchen table in daylight, honest props, the real bottles sharp and identical to the photo, a printed phone photo of the pain moment lying on the table.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Calm and honest: she lays out everything she tried and what she is trying now.
global_identity.graphic_language: Raw photo with a bold white headline on the table, a blush ingredient pill, a handwritten sticky note and a slim plum band with 3 trust seals.
global_identity.text_typography: Headlines in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black look), uppercase; secondary texts in a rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold / Bold look); the sticky note in a casual handwritten marker script.

creative_objective: Tell the young slim woman's story without a speech: on the left the printed mirror photo of her feeling flat beside the dumbbell, the glute band and the jeans she tried; a measuring tape divides; on the right the three bottles of the 3-month plan. The headline names the main benefit (curves the natural way) and the band removes the risk.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) the printed photo of her at the mirror and the three bottles, 2) the headline 'CURVAS AL NATURAL', 3) the ingredient pill and the sticky note, 4) the bottom band with 3 seals.
art_direction.composition_style: Pure top-down view; the measuring tape runs vertically at the center as a divider; left half the 'what did not work' group, right half the three bottles; text sits in the empty table space above the bottles.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Objects laid out with breathing room like the reference; the tape from 12% to 86% height; band at the bottom 12%.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft window daylight from the top left, short soft shadows to the lower right, a little natural table wear and a few crumbs.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 native overhead smartphone photo, camera straight down (90 degrees) over a light oak kitchen table #D9B27C with visible grain, small scratches and a few crumbs, soft window daylight from the top left, short soft shadows to the lower right, natural colors, unedited look. TOP ZONE (0–10% height): bare table. MIDDLE ZONE (10–88% height). CENTER: a soft pink fabric tailor's measuring tape laid perfectly straight vertically from 12% to 86% height at 50% width, its tiny printed marks too small to read, splitting the table into two halves. LEFT HALF (3–47% width): at the top (8–62% height, 3–46% width) a large printed 4:5 phone photo with a thin white border, lying slightly rotated 4 degrees, about 26% of the canvas: inside it, a slim Colombian woman around 23, warm tan skin with visible pores and a few freckles, long straight black hair, white cropped t-shirt and tight light-wash skinny jeans, standing in side profile in front of her bedroom mirror holding her phone up for a selfie, the other hand flat on her hip, her hip and seat line straight with no curve, lips pressed and eyes down at her own reflection, disappointed; warm bedroom lamp light, an unmade bed behind. Below the photo (64–86% height): a pastel lilac #B9A3D9 neoprene hex dumbbell lying diagonally with no readable text, a pink fabric glute resistance band in a loose loop, and a pair of light-wash jeans folded in a neat square. RIGHT HALF (53–97% width). Top (6–30% height): the headline in 2 lines, left-aligned at 56% width, Montserrat Black uppercase, white #FFFFFF with a soft dark drop shadow so it reads on wood, line 1 'CURVAS' about 9% of the canvas height, line 2 'AL NATURAL' in hot fuchsia #E6177F with a thin white outline, about 7% high. Under it (31–37% height): a rounded blush pink #FBE3EE pill with dark plum #2B1226 Poppins Bold uppercase text. To its right (36–46% height, 80–96% width): a square sticky-note yellow #FFE27A note, slightly rotated, with a handwritten black marker phrase in 2 lines. Bottom right (46–86% height): three identical real product bottles lying flat on the table, labels facing straight up to the camera and readable, arranged like the reference (two side by side and one slightly lower between them), each about 30% of the canvas height, soft contact shadows. PRODUCT: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottles; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret them. A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with straight vertical sides and no neck: a wide-mouth bottle whose glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap is almost as wide as the body (about 90% of its width) and about one fifth of the total height, printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern; not a slim bottle and not a squat jar. A solid hot-pink band wraps the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. Matte finish, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare. Always closed with caps on; no loose capsules; labels read the right way round, never mirrored. BOTTOM ZONE (88–100% height): a full-width dark plum #2B1226 band divided into 3 equal parts by thin bubblegum pink vertical lines: left, a rounded badge with a solid 3 px hot-fuchsia border and a white shield line icon with the registration text in white Poppins Bold uppercase on two lines; center, a white hand-and-coin line icon and 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' in white Montserrat Black uppercase; right, a white bottle line icon and the capsules text in white Poppins Bold uppercase on two lines. All texts crisp, spelled exactly with correct accents, nothing else written anywhere.

mandatory_visual_elements: Large printed phone photo on the table (at least 25% of the canvas): slim young woman at her bedroom mirror in side profile, tight light jeans, flat hip line, disappointed look
Lilac dumbbell, pink fabric glute band and folded light-wash jeans on the left
Pink tailor's measuring tape laid vertically at the center
Three identical real closed bottles lying flat on the right, labels up and readable
Yellow sticky note with the handwritten phrase
Dark plum bottom band with 3 seals, including 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR' and the bordered registration badge
final_generation_exclusions: No capsules or pills anywhere; no open bottle; no other brand; no readable text on the dumbbell or props
No prices, percentages, ratings, testimonials or 'envío gratis'
No logos; never write the words 'AGREGAR' or 'LOGO Y SELLO DE'
No pedestal, no studio backdrop: it is a real table photo
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.
Do not add prices, extra badges, benefit lists, ratings, testimonials, discount labels or extra claims beyond the listed band, seals and texts.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. 'Curvas al natural' and 'a tu ritmo' are aspirational, with no promised results, no times, no comparisons with other people and no medical claims; the seals are only the user's registration and true product facts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
